_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: With 0 of 50 12h windows producing ±2+ point moves over 7 days, this is a verified compression regime where HOLD with conviction is the skilled call — the coil resolves eventually but no breaker has triggered yet.
next_move.brains_agree: Both brains agree on HOLD/sideways — analyst calls it explicitly, narrative implies it by describing a shakeout before structural reset rather than an imminent directional move.
next_move.confirmed_if: Stablecoin growth breaks above 45 AND funding cools below 40 with BTC holding $62k — this would shift the coil toward upward resolution into Denial/Anxiety
next_move.invalidated_if: VIX spikes above 75 with DXY breaking 103 and BTC losing $60k, OR ETF flows collapse below 70 with stablecoin growth staying sub-40 — this would break the coil downward into Capitulation
